plain_description: **Build 3D models and manage image-processing workflows with a visual, node-based tool.** Run work locally or across a render farm, and inspect image and 3D results as you go.
technical_description: Meshroom is an open-source, node-based visual programming framework for creating and running data-processing pipelines. It supports local and distributed execution, caches intermediate results, and includes plugins for 3D reconstruction, camera tracking, image segmentation, depth estimation, and other computer vision tasks. Its interface includes a graph editor, node editor, and 2D and 3D viewers.
title: Meshroom
